title: code-review-cheap finding set
description: Output contract for the single AI review pass. validate_findings.py rejects anything that doesn't match this shape rather than letting it through as a silent clean review.

questions.description: Uncertainties or missing evidence the reviewer noticed but couldn't resolve from the given context. Never a disguised finding.

category.description: e.g. correctness, security, contract-mismatch, data-integrity, regression, missing-validation

file.description: Path exactly as it appears in the inspected diff — validate_findings.py checks this against the diff snapshot, not the live working tree.

trigger.description: Concrete triggering conditions — the input/state that provokes the failure.

consequence.description: What actually goes wrong — crash, wrong output, data loss, security bypass.

evidence.description: What in the diff/context connects the change to the failure. Not a restatement of the title.

verification_status.description: model-hypothesis: reviewer's read of the code only. statically-supported: corroborated by a deterministic check's output (lint/type/grep). reproduced-by-check: an executed test/check actually failed because of this.
